0.content: Vesna is the Druzhna Commander and Danica's childhood friend and fellow right hand of the Tsaritsa. Vesna handles military decrees while Danica handles state affairs. Vesna pranks Danica often, slipping vegetables onto her plate, while Danica brings up Vesna's reckless train driving, which earned a six-month driving ban. They argue over who is older: Danica says they are the same age; Vesna says she is two months older.

1.content: Capitano was First of the Fatui Harbingers and Danica's teacher in martial arts. Children who passed a selection exam were taught by him personally. He hoped to leave "embers" behind. Danica and Vesna tried to steal his mask once and were punished. Danica thanked the Traveler for helping him fulfil a lifelong wish.

2.comment: Danica: Mora game and the Podvorye test
2.content: At Podvorye Restaurant Danica sat with the Traveler and Paimon, asked questions about their record with the Fatui and what they thought of the Tsaritsa, and then proposed the Mora game: she tosses a Mora coin and aims for it to land on the table, while the Traveler tries to prevent that. Vesna interrupted and paid the bill. The Tsaritsa later rebuked Danica for risking the trust of a potential ally.

3.comment: Danica: Seals of Life and Svetloledovka
3.content: She joined Vesna and the Traveler in Svetloledovka to collect the seals from the town, and checked the train schedule back to Snezhnograd. At the Mirror of Remembrance she warned bystanders to stand away if they did not want their memories read. In a memory shown by the Mirror, Vesna greets her back after eight years away, and Danica says it is not a return: "we" will create a new storm that will rage until the Old World has been utterly demolished.

4.content: Danica calls her "Her Majesty". She says her family has served the Tsaritsa for three generations, and that the Tsaritsa allowed her to leave as a mercenary. The Tsaritsa called her "Head Maid and trusted personal attendant". Danica refuses to let her go into town in disguise ("Danica would never allow it"). Vesna says that in the palace the Tsaritsa gazes at the snowstorm while Danica stands silent beside her.

5.content: When Rhinedottir came to Zapolyarny Palace, Danica prepared the palace and told the maids that every guest, whether an envoy of the heavens or a beggar, receives the same care. She escorted Rhinedottir and stated that a guest is only a guest to her.

6.content: In this world quest, Danica noticed Vesna's repeated absences, followed Odette and Vodyanitsa to the final sword spirit confrontation, watched from a cliff, and told Vesna to tidy up the mess without helping in the fight. Afterwards she explained that the Vila forge magical weapons by merging elemental energy with their own consciousness, so each sword spirit embodies one of Vesna's wishes.
